title: FR: Trend Alert
symptom: The user requests a new alert feature for detecting trends in blood glucose over longer periods (e.g., 30-60 minutes) with configurable thresholds and time windows, as the existing BG Rising/Falling Fast alert only works for short, extreme changes.
evidence_quote: But I'd wish to have indication/alert of more long-timed BG rising (about 30--60 minutes) which often is more smooth than that can be specified with BG Rising/Falling Fast.
